canDoYue: 你識要帳單、分開計、用八達通，同埋指出單上面嘅錯。
canDoEn: Ask for the bill, split it, pay with an Octopus card, and point out a mistake.

dialogue.speaker: eddy
dialogue.text: Could we have the bill for this table before we leave?
dialogue.glossYue: 走之前可唔可以攞呢張檯嘅帳單？
dialogue.say: Could we have the bill for this table before we leave?

dialogue.speaker: nori
dialogue.text: Here is the bill, and the service charge is included.
dialogue.say: Here is the bill, and the service charge is included.

dialogue.speaker: eddy
dialogue.text: Could we split the bill and get a separate receipt?
dialogue.glossYue: 可唔可以分開埋單，再要一張分開嘅收據？
dialogue.say: Could we split the bill and get a separate receipt?

dialogue.speaker: nori
dialogue.text: Yes, we can split it and show both amounts.
dialogue.glossYue: 可以分開，我會顯示兩個數。
dialogue.say: Yes, we can split it and show both amounts.

dialogue.speaker: eddy
dialogue.text: I will pay my separate amount with an Octopus card.
dialogue.say: I will pay my separate amount with an Octopus card.

dialogue.speaker: nori
dialogue.text: I can take that Octopus card and print a receipt.
dialogue.glossYue: 我收八達通，然後印收據。
dialogue.say: I can take that Octopus card and print a receipt.

dialogue.speaker: eddy
dialogue.text: There is a mistake on the bill, and the soup was extra.
dialogue.glossYue: 帳單有個錯，湯係額外嘅。
dialogue.say: There is a mistake on the bill, and the soup was extra.

dialogue.speaker: nori
dialogue.text: I will correct that mistake and bring the new bill.
dialogue.glossYue: 我會改好嗰個錯，再帶新帳單嚟。
dialogue.say: I will correct that mistake and bring the new bill.
